longDescription: VINW (Vibe Is Not Wish) is a spiral-ascend software engineering process control engine. It organizes requirements decomposition, evidence gathering, design refinement, implementation, testing, review, and final verification into a non-linear spiral workflow with baseline freeze, ascent rollback, confirmation gates, and atomic change logging. Ensures code generation is constrained, traceable, and verifiable.
tryPrompts: Develop a Python CLI tool using VINW workflow
Start a VINW project and decompose requirements
Check consistency and generate a report for my VINW project

vinw-workflow.description: Guides AI through a strict 7-layer spiral software engineering process with baseline freeze, ascent rollback, confirmation gates, and change traceability.
